page.layout: One blank page of paper inside a leather binding; no printed text, no margins with text.
page.notes: The scan shows the inside of a book cover (brown leather or boards, with a hinge and sewing thread at the right edge) and a blank endleaf. There is no printed text, no page number, no running head, no catchword and no signature. Only stains, speckles and show-through appear, and these are not transcribed.
